headline: Cunha's brace powers Brazil to 3-0 halftime lead against Haiti in World Cup qualifier
summary: Matheus Cunha scored two goals and Vinicius Jr. added another, securing a dominant performance for Brazil in the first half of their FIFA World Cup group stage match.
details: Brazil took a commanding 3-0 lead against Haiti in the first half of their 2026 FIFA World Cup group stage match in Philadelphia. Matheus Cunha opened the scoring in the 23rd minute, capitalizing on a deflection after a Vinicius Jr. shot.

Cunha doubled Brazil's advantage 13 minutes later, unleashing a powerful left-footed shot into the net from a pass by Vinicius Jr. This marked a brace for the forward, putting Brazil firmly in control.

Vinicius Jr. himself found the back of the net just before halftime during extra time. He calmly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper after receiving a high pass from Lucas Paqueta, scoring his second goal of the tournament.

headline: Storm and rain warning for 8 districts with 60 km/h winds by noon
summary: Eight districts in Bangladesh are under a storm and rain alert, with winds potentially reaching 60 km/h. Residents are advised to stay vigilant as the weather is expected to intensify by noon.
details: A storm and rain warning has been issued for eight districts across Bangladesh. The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) forecasts winds reaching speeds of up to 60 km/h.
The alert is valid until noon today, urging residents in the affected areas to exercise caution. People are advised to stay indoors and secure loose objects.
Authorities are monitoring the situation closely and will provide further updates. Necessary precautions should be taken to ensure public safety during this period.
